# Remy's Lab

> Dog products tested by an actual Lab.

Remy's Lab is a TikTok-connected dog product testing brand built around Remy, a yellow Labrador. The site helps dog owners find product notes, partner links, discount codes, and practical dog owner guides without a hard sell.

## Pages

- [Remy's Lab home](https://remyslab.com/): Current product links, discount codes, and affiliate disclosure.
- [Lab Notes](https://remyslab.com/blog/): Written notes after Remy actually uses a product.
- [Dog Owner Guides](https://remyslab.com/guides/): Practical evergreen answers for common dog owner problems.

## Lab Notes

- [Hound Huddle Bandana: Remy's Test Notes](https://remyslab.com/blog/hound-huddle-bandana-review): Football print bandana from Brooks & Roo. Great fit in XL, lightweight and breathable. Too early to judge long-term wear.
- [Bissell PowerClean FurFinder 200W: Remy's Test Notes](https://remyslab.com/blog/bissell-powerclean-furfinder-vacuum-review): Cordless stick vacuum that's become our daily driver. Powerful, quiet, gets under furniture easily. Battery runs shorter than the claimed 40 minutes.
- [Vila Puzzle Feeder: Remy's Test Notes](https://remyslab.com/blog/vila-puzzle-feeder-review): A sliding-compartment puzzle feeder. Remy cleared it instantly, no help needed. Good entry-level puzzle, not much of a challenge for him.
- [USA Chicken Feet Dog Chews: Remy's Test Notes](https://remyslab.com/blog/usa-chicken-feet-dog-chew-review): Remy was curious at first, now loves them. 20 to 25 minutes per chew, low smell, good for teeth. A versatile option when you want something quicker than a bully stick.
- [Wild Wolf Angus Bully Sticks: Remy's Test Notes](https://remyslab.com/blog/wild-wolf-angus-bully-sticks-review): Remy's second favorite chew. 12-inch Angus bully sticks that last 1 to 1.5 hours. A little more smell than Mighty Paw but a clean product he loves.
- [Potaroma Dog Puzzle Toy: Remy's Test Notes](https://remyslab.com/blog/potaroma-dog-puzzle-toy-review): A 2-level puzzle toy that turns food or treats into a little job for Remy and helps slow him down.
- [Pack Leashes Dino Collar Set: Remy's Test Notes](https://remyslab.com/blog/pack-leashes-dino-collar-set-review): Remy is currently wearing the Dino collar. Easy to adjust, sturdy metal buckle, and a leash ring. The downside is that it is not reflective at night.
- [Mighty Paw Naturals Bully Sticks: Remy's Test Notes](https://remyslab.com/blog/mighty-paw-naturals-bully-sticks-review): Remy knows the sound of the bag. Single-ingredient beef chews with less odor than other bully sticks we have tried.
- [FURemover Pet Hair Broom: Remy's Test Notes](https://remyslab.com/blog/furemover-pet-hair-broom-review): Rubber bristles pull embedded Lab hair out of carpet and work well on hardwood floors too.
- [BLACK+DECKER Pet Hair Roller: Remy's Test Notes](https://remyslab.com/blog/black-decker-pet-hair-roller-review): Tested on a black felt couch, regular couch, comforter, and clothes. Great swap for lint rollers.

## Dog Owner Guides

- [How to Get Dog Hair Out of Carpet When Vacuuming Is Not Enough](https://remyslab.com/guides/how-to-get-dog-hair-out-of-carpet): Vacuum the carpet first, then use a rubber carpet rake in short overlapping pulls to loosen the dog hair trapped deeper in the fibers. Gather the fur into a pile, remove it, then vacuum one more time. The rake takes more effort, but it can grab hair a regular vacuum leaves behind.
- [How to Remove Dog Hair From a Couch Without Burning Through Lint Rollers](https://remyslab.com/guides/how-to-remove-dog-hair-from-couch): Sticky lint roller sheets disappear fast when you have a Lab. Here is the reusable couch-cleaning option that worked better for us.
- [Rubber Broom vs Vacuum for Pet Hair: Which One Actually Works Better?](https://remyslab.com/guides/rubber-broom-vs-vacuum-for-pet-hair): A vacuum is faster, but a rubber broom can grab fur still trapped in the rug. Here is when each tool actually makes sense.
